request.query: For a real X at least 2, sqrt X is strictly less than the natural floor of X, and the natural floor cast to real is at most X

      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {a : ℕ}, √↑a < ↑a.sqrt + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \\sqrt{a} < \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor + 1 $, where $ \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.",

      "informal_description": "For any natural number $n$ greater than 1, the square root of $n$ is strictly less than $n$, i.e., $\\sqrt{n} < n$.",

      "informal_name": "Square Root of $n + 1$ is at Most $n$ for Non-Zero $n$",

items.informal_name: Real Square Root is Less Than Natural Square Root Plus One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \sqrt{a} < \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor + 1 $, where $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.

items.informal_name: Square Root Less Than Self for Natural Numbers Greater Than One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ greater than 1, the square root of $n$ is strictly less than $n$, i.e., $\sqrt{n} < n$.

items.informal_name: Real Square Root is Less Than or Equal to Integer Square Root Plus One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \sqrt{a} \leq \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor + 1 $, where $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.

items.informal_name: Natural Square Root is Less Than or Equal to Real Square Root
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the natural square root of $ a $ is less than or equal to the real square root of $ a $.

items.informal_name: Square Root of $n + 1$ is at Most $n$ for Non-Zero $n$
items.informal_description: For any non-zero natural number $n$, the square root of $n + 1$ is less than or equal to $n$.

items.informal_name: Floor of Real Square Root Equals Natural Square Root
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the floor of the real square root of $ a $ is equal to the natural number square root of $ a $, i.e., $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor = \sqrt{a} $.

items.informal_name: Floor of Real Square Root Equals Natural Square Root
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the floor of the square root of $ a $ (considered as a real number) is equal to the natural number square root of $ a $, i.e., $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor = \text{Nat.sqrt}(a) $.

items.informal_name: Square of Integer Square Root is Less Than Successor
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the square of the integer square root of $ n $ is strictly less than $ n + 1 $, i.e., $ (\lfloor \sqrt{n} \rfloor)^2 < n + 1 $.
